detail: Available Sites database tools expose schema names or whole bounded table rows, with no selected-column, owner filter or aggregate interface. The ordinary events API initializes/seeds and returns private event payloads; the separate administrator diagnostic can disclose current source. Neither is a metadata-only eligibility probe. No such reads were attempted.
intendedWorkspace: Existing personal workspace used by the prior N4 cases; no reset, clone or source edit.
capacityDecision: Keep128. There is no fresh complete authorized count or resource measurement establishing a safe larger supported bound. Historical full-stream sequence numbers are not the canonical workspace census. No truncation or event-only exception.
minimumFollowup: Obtain an owner-scoped, read-only aggregate over the exact canonical workspace profile: total count, payload byte footprint and grouped type/actor counts, with current custody/scope exclusion counts. Then, only if in bound, qualify canonical source semantics and snapshot without providers. A new endpoint or broader authority is not part of this release.
